faqs.question: What services do you offer as a web developer?
faqs.answer: I offer a full range of web development services, including responsive website design and development, CMS implementation and customization (especially Drupal and WordPress), performance optimization, API integration, and technology consulting to help you choose the best solutions for your project.

faqs.question: What is your experience in web development?
faqs.answer: I have over a year of hands-on experience in web development, with a special focus on CMS like Drupal and WordPress. I have worked on projects ranging from personal websites to complex enterprise platforms, always seeking to implement best practices and the latest technologies.

faqs.question: What makes you unique as a developer?
faqs.answer: As an active Systems Engineering student and a constant learner at Platzi, I combine cutting-edge technical knowledge with a fresh, innovative perspective. My passion for technology and my commitment to continuous learning allow me to offer web solutions that are not only functional but also innovative and future-proof.

faqs.question: How do you ensure quality in your projects?
faqs.answer: I implement a rigorous quality control approach that includes comprehensive testing, code review, and adherence to industry best practices. Additionally, I use continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) tools to ensure that every delivery meets the highest standards of quality and performance.

faqs.question: Do you offer post-launch support?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. I offer complete post-launch maintenance and support services to ensure your website continues to function optimally. This includes security updates, performance optimizations, and ongoing technical assistance.
